lines.text: Previously. Kurozane challenged Sieg at the pass shrine, six years after Grey Hollow.
lines.tts: Previously. Kurozane challenged Seeg at the pass shrine, six years after Grey Hollow.

lines.text: Sieg made his honest blade lie, just once. Then Sable set the grey pack on us.
lines.tts: Seeg made his honest blade lie, just once. Then Sable set the grey pack on us.

lines.text: Kurozane turned on his own pack. And Sieg laughed again.
lines.tts: Kurozane turned on his own pack. And Seeg laughed again.

lines.text: Now we are at the gates of the golden city. Haruki is somewhere inside.
lines.tts: Now we are at the gates of the golden city. Hah-roo-kee is somewhere inside.

lines.text: Takuto is late. He is always late. The cat is going to give up on us.
lines.tts: Tah-koo-toh is late. He is always late. The cat is going to give up on us.

lines.text: What... what is that? The sky is cracking.
I am falling. I am falling. Stop. Stop. STOP.
...It stopped.
Welcome, Skyfallen. Do not be afraid. You stopped time to save yourself. That is a rare gift.
I am going to send you home. All of you. Someday.
This is a golden carriage. I am inside a golden carriage. My mom would faint.
The seats are made of clouds. I am never getting out.
The road is paved with marble. Marble. In the frontier towns people eat bark in winter.
Saint Lumen has always been rich. The Gilded Order guards the capital. The capital pays for the Order. Everyone is happy.
Everyone inside the walls.
...Yes. Everyone inside the walls.
Tell me about Lucien.
Lucien Aurel. The Golden Saint. Rank S, the only one in a generation. His Brand is called Sanctum.
Golden barriers. He has held a whole city wall against a Calamity with them. Nothing has ever broken a Sanctum. Nothing.
Nothing?
Ha. Nothing. I love that word. It is a door with a sign on it that says knock.
It's talking. I can see it on your face.
It wants to knock.
Tell it no.
I always tell it no.
Guys. Guys. There is a statue. Of a guy. A giant gold statue of a guy who is alive.
Praise the Saint! Praise the golden wall!
Hunters from the frontier! The Saint has guests!
Everyone is smiling. All the time. Even the dogs.
Is that bad?
Nobody smiles all the time. Not even me, and I am asleep half the time.
Candles blessed by the Saint! Keep the Rifts away! Two silver!
The Saint will send the Skyfallen home! He promised!
Did you hear that? Send the Skyfallen home. That is us. That is me.
Wick.
I know. I know. Nobody ever goes home. But what if, Takuto? What if this one time?
lines.tts: I know. I know. Nobody ever goes home. But what if, Tah-koo-toh? What if this one time?

lines.text: ...Then I would want it to be true too.
Sieg Valen. The Laughing Blade. You are taller than the songs say.
lines.tts: Seeg Valen. The Laughing Blade. You are taller than the songs say.

lines.text: Saint Lucien. You are exactly as tall as the statues.
Ha! The sculptors were generous with the hair. And you must be Takuto Kirishima. The error.
lines.tts: Ha! The sculptors were generous with the hair. And you must be Tah-koo-toh Kee-ree-shee-mah. The error.

lines.text: Where is Haruki?
lines.tts: Where is Hah-roo-kee?

lines.text: Straight to the point. He told me you would be.
Haruki is here, and he is safe. He will see you when he is ready. He asked for a little time.
lines.tts: Hah-roo-kee is here, and he is safe. He will see you when he is ready. He asked for a little time.

lines.text: Ready for what?
To explain why he never came back to the crossing. That is not an easy thing to say to a friend.
Takuto. I want to make you an offer. The Gilded Order would be honoured to have you.
lines.tts: Tah-koo-toh. I want to make you an offer. The Gilded Order would be honoured to have you.

lines.text: He is rank F.
He is rank ERROR, Miss Ashveil. Brands like his appear once in three hundred years. Ruinbreaker. The Brand that breaks Brands.
lines.tts: He is rank ERROR, Miss Ash-vale. Brands like his appear once in three hundred years. Ruinbreaker. The Brand that breaks Brands.

lines.text: My Sanctum protects. Your axe destroys. Together, we could close every Rift in the world.
And the Skyfallen? The people in the plaza said you are sending us home.
The Homeward Rite. Yes. I have spent twelve years on it. It is close. It needs Brands, many Brands, given willingly.
Given?
Lent, say. A little of their light, to open a Rift that goes the right way. Haruki has helped. Every Skyfallen who stays here helps.
lines.tts: Lent, say. A little of their light, to open a Rift that goes the right way. Hah-roo-kee has helped. Every Skyfallen who stays here helps.

lines.text: And how many have gone home so far?
...None yet. That is the honest answer. But none yet is not never, Sieg.
lines.tts: ...None yet. That is the honest answer. But none yet is not never, Seeg.

lines.text: Listen to his voice, boy. Every word is warm. Every word is gold. Gold does not get warm by itself.
I will think about it.
That is all I ask. Stay as my guests. Eat. Sleep. See the city. And go to the garden. Someone is waiting there.
Walk with me, Takuto. The candles are prettiest at this hour.
lines.tts: Walk with me, Tah-koo-toh. The candles are prettiest at this hour.

lines.text: You are trying to recruit me again.
I am trying to explain myself. That is harder.
I was born on the frontier. A village called Ember Reach. You have never heard of it. Nobody has, anymore.
When I was nine, a Rift opened over the well. I watched the sky eat my mother. I was the only one who woke up.
...Like Nemu. Like Rin. Like Sieg.
lines.tts: ...Like Neh-moo. Like Rin. Like Seeg.

lines.text: Like everyone, Takuto. This world is made of people who woke up alone. My Brand woke that day. A wall. Of course it was a wall.
lines.tts: Like everyone, Tah-koo-toh. This world is made of people who woke up alone. My Brand woke that day. A wall. Of course it was a wall.

lines.text: I have spent my whole life building walls so that no child wakes up alone again. That is all the gold is. Walls.
The people in the undercity are cold.
...Walls cost something. I never pretended they were free.
Who pays?
Whoever must. Usually me. Goodnight, Takuto.
lines.tts: Whoever must. Usually me. Goodnight, Tah-koo-toh.

lines.text: A sad story, told beautifully. I told stories like that once. Right before I burned the city.
Haruki.
lines.tts: Hah-roo-kee.

lines.text: ...You found me. Of course you found me.
Did you feed the cat?
Every night.
Coffee milk?
Coffee milk.
...Ha. That is a terrible thing to give a cat. I am so glad.
You never came back. Two years. Your mother put your face on every pole in Nerima.
lines.tts: You never came back. Two years. Your mother put your face on every pole in Neh-ree-mah.

lines.text: I know. I mean, I did not know. But I knew she would.
Come back with us. We will find a way. Together. Like before.
There is no way back, Takuto. Not yet. That is what we are building here.
lines.tts: There is no way back, Tah-koo-toh. Not yet. That is what we are building here.

lines.text: Lucien's Rite.
He saved my life. I was falling through a crack in the sky, and he caught me with gold. He gave me a home, and a reason.
When the Rite is ready, everyone goes home. My mother. Wick. Every Skyfallen in this world. You.
And until then?
Until then I stay. And I help.
I came all this way to bring you back.
I did not ask you to, Takuto. I never asked anyone to.
lines.tts: I did not ask you to, Tah-koo-toh. I never asked anyone to.

lines.text: ...You did not have to ask.
That is the worst thing about you. You never wait to be asked.
Please. Do not break anything here. This city is the only thing I have built in two years.
This way, honoured guests. The Hall of the Homeward Rite. Speak softly, please.
The volunteers rest in the golden chairs. A little of their light flows into the great seal.
When the seal is full, the Rite opens a road home.
Those people in the chairs. Are they Skyfallen?
Some are. Some are faithful citizens. All are willing. You may volunteer, if you wish, young sir.
Me? I could... I could help open the road? To Osaka?
lines.tts: Me? I could... I could help open the road? To Oh-sah-kah?

lines.text: They are not sleeping. I know what sleeping looks like. They are not sleeping.
But if it works, Nemu. My mom's shop. Four tables.
lines.tts: But if it works, Neh-moo. My mom's shop. Four tables.

lines.text: Wick. Look at their hands.
...They are grey. Their Brands. The marks on their hands are grey.
Not today. Okay? Not today.
...Okay. Not today. But Takuto, if there is a road home, and it costs a little light...
lines.tts: ...Okay. Not today. But Tah-koo-toh, if there is a road home, and it costs a little light...

lines.text: Then we find out what a little means. First.
There is a whole roast bird. Inside a bigger roast bird. Inside a pig. Takuto. It is a bird pig.
lines.tts: There is a whole roast bird. Inside a bigger roast bird. Inside a pig. Tah-koo-toh. It is a bird pig.

lines.text: Eat it, then.
I am going to eat it. I am going to eat all three layers. Respectfully.
The cake has a castle on it. I am going to sleep in the castle.
You are Nemu. Takuto's first friend here. He told me about you. Nine lives?
lines.tts: You are Neh-moo. Tah-koo-toh's first friend here. He told me about you. Nine lives?

lines.text: Two left. He told you about me?
He talked about you for an hour. Takuto never talks about anyone for an hour.
lines.tts: He talked about you for an hour. Tah-koo-toh never talks about anyone for an hour.

lines.text: ...Mm. I like you.
Saint Lucien. The Rifts. Something is herding Fiends toward your city. Giants, ogres, a Hydra. Did you know?
The Order watches every road, Miss Ashveil. We know the frontier is restless.
lines.tts: The Order watches every road, Miss Ash-vale. We know the frontier is restless.

lines.text: There is a man in a black suit. He opens Rifts. He smells like static.
...A frightening story. The frontier is full of them. My scholars will look into it.
You did not ask what he looked like.
You said he wore a black suit. I assumed the rest was black too. More wine, Sieg?
lines.tts: You said he wore a black suit. I assumed the rest was black too. More wine, Seeg?

lines.text: No. Thank you. I am counting tonight.
Haruki. One question. Then I will leave you alone.
lines.tts: Hah-roo-kee. One question. Then I will leave you alone.

lines.text: You are Rin. The one with the thread. He talks about you too. Less than Nemu, but louder.
lines.tts: You are Rin. The one with the thread. He talks about you too. Less than Neh-moo, but louder.

lines.text: What does consecrated mean?
...Where did you hear that word?
In your Saint's archive. Next to forty Skyfallen names. Next to yours, soon. It has a gold seal.
It means they finished their part of the Rite. They are resting. Lucien told me.
Have you ever seen one of them? After they finished resting?
My brother went into a Rift and never came out. I would give anything to have someone tell me he was only resting.
That is why I do not believe anyone who says it.
You do not know him.
No. And you do not know what the word means. Find out. Before Takuto does something stupid about it.
lines.tts: No. And you do not know what the word means. Find out. Before Tah-koo-toh does something stupid about it.

lines.text: You picked the lock on a holy archive.
My brother taught me. You came with me.
Someone has to be the adult who gets arrested. What did you find?
Skyfallen reports. Every Guild sent its reports here. Forty names in twenty years.
Every one of them has the same mark at the end. A gold seal. And one word. Consecrated.
Consecrated.
Not sent home. Not dead. Consecrated. What does that mean, Sieg?
lines.tts: Not sent home. Not dead. Consecrated. What does that mean, Seeg?

lines.text: In the old church, it meant given to the light. Offered.
Haruki's name is on the last page. No seal yet.
lines.tts: Hah-roo-kee's name is on the last page. No seal yet.

lines.text: ...Yet.
There is another page. A new one. Fresh ink.
Whose name?
Takuto Kirishima. Ruinbreaker. And next to it, in Lucien's hand. Remove before consecration.
lines.tts: Tah-koo-toh Kee-ree-shee-mah. Ruinbreaker. And next to it, in Lucien's hand. Remove before consecration.

lines.text: Remove the Brand? Or remove the boy?
It does not say.
Why are you on the roof?
It is the only place in this city that is not gold.
The light in the Rite Hall. Takuto, it felt like the cold part. The part before the blanket.
lines.tts: The light in the Rite Hall. Tah-koo-toh, it felt like the cold part. The part before the blanket.

lines.text: The cold part of dying.
I have felt it seven times. I know it. Those people in the chairs are in the cold part. And nobody is letting them reach the blanket.
...Nemu.
lines.tts: ...Neh-moo.

lines.text: I am scared of this city. I have never been scared of a place before. Only of things.
Then we leave as soon as I have Haruki.
lines.tts: Then we leave as soon as I have Hah-roo-kee.

lines.text: And if he will not come?
...Then I break whatever is holding him.
Even if it is gold?
Especially if it is gold.
You still cannot sleep in new places.
You still know that.
I know everything about you. It is very boring. You only have two settings.
Asleep and in a fight.
Asleep and in a fight.
How did you get your Brand?
Falling. Out of the Rift, over the city. I thought, if time would just stop for one second, I could think.
And it did. Three seconds, actually. Frozen Hour. I touch something and it stops. Look.
One leaf. Three seconds.
...That is amazing.
Your turn. What happened with the axe?
A girl died protecting me in a graveyard. I pulled the axe out of a grave, and I broke the thing that killed her.
Nemu.
lines.tts: Neh-moo.

lines.text: Nemu. She got up again. She does that.
lines.tts: Neh-moo. She got up again. She does that.

lines.text: And the thing in the axe?
...You know about that?
Lucien knows about it. He says your Brand is the most dangerous thing in the world. That is why he wants you close.
Close, or locked up?
...He is a good man, Takuto. He caught me. He is trying to save everyone.
lines.tts: ...He is a good man, Tah-koo-toh. He caught me. He is trying to save everyone.

lines.text: You put your hand on my shoulder every time I was about to break something.
I remember.
If I am wrong about him, do it again. If you are wrong about him, let me.
...Deal. Like the cat.
Spar with me. Like the old days. No Brands.
We never sparred in the old days. We just fought high schoolers.
You fought high schoolers. I watched. Fine, Brands, then. Come on.
Frozen Hour.
Nnngh...!
You... broke out? It has only been two seconds!
He broke your freeze.
Nobody breaks my freeze. Three seconds. Always three. It is a rule.
I was angry.
You are always angry.
I was angrier.
Ruinbreaker breaks Brands. Your freeze is a Brand.
...So you could break his too. Lucien's.
I cracked it. That is all.
That is not all, Takuto. That is everything.
lines.tts: That is not all, Tah-koo-toh. That is everything.

lines.text: Haruki. Do you know how far he walked to get here?
lines.tts: Hah-roo-kee. Do you know how far he walked to get here?

lines.text: From Ashford. Lucien said.
From a graveyard. Then Ashford. Then the Bramble Wastes, a river town with a Hydra, a fort under siege, a forest full of ogres, a mountain with a wolf on it.
Every night, he asked me if we were closer. Every single night.
...He never asks anyone anything.
He asked me. Two hundred times. I counted. It is a thing I do.
Why are you telling me this?
Because one day soon you will have to choose who to stand next to. I want you to know what that boy paid for the chance.
Well, Takuto? Will you wear the gold?
lines.tts: Well, Tah-koo-toh? Will you wear the gold?

lines.text: No.
...Just no?
Just no.
Ha. Haruki said you would say exactly that. Then indulge me in one thing, before you go. A test. For my curiosity.
lines.tts: Ha. Hah-roo-kee said you would say exactly that. Then indulge me in one thing, before you go. A test. For my curiosity.

lines.text: Sanctum. My barrier. Nothing has ever broken it. Strike it, with everything you have. Let me see Ruinbreaker for myself.
Takuto. Careful.
lines.tts: Tah-koo-toh. Careful.

lines.text: Knock knock, boy. Knock as hard as you like. I will not even ask to help. I want to see his face.
Sanctum.
Break.
It... cracked.
...A hairline. One hairline. In twelve years, nothing has scratched it.
Wonderful. Truly. Thank you, Takuto. You have given me a great deal to think about.
lines.tts: Wonderful. Truly. Thank you, Tah-koo-toh. You have given me a great deal to think about.

lines.text: Did you see it? For one heartbeat his face went white. The Saint is afraid of you, boy.
Rin. It says he is afraid.
Good. So am I. Of him.
I did not know there was a down here. The carriage never comes down here.
Everyone is tired. Not sleepy tired. Empty tired.
Are you Hunters? Real ones?
I had a mark too, once. A little one. The light took it.
The light?
At the Rite. They said it was for the Skyfallen. It did not hurt. I just got cold. I am always cold now.
...Lent. A little of their light. That is what he said.
He said given willingly. She is seven.
Lost, Ruinbreaker? The Saint keeps his leftovers down here.
Sable!
He is gone. The air tastes like a battery.
He is here. In Lucien's city. Walking around like he owns it.
Takuto. What if he does own it?
lines.tts: Tah-koo-toh. What if he does own it?

lines.text: Your friend cracked my Sanctum.
He can break anything. He always could.
Then we must keep him close, Haruki. For his own safety. And for the city's.
lines.tts: Then we must keep him close, Hah-roo-kee. For his own safety. And for the city's.

lines.text: He said no.
People say no to gifts. Then they learn what the gift was for.
Lucien. The undercity. Takuto went down there today. He asked me why the people are cold.
lines.tts: Lucien. The undercity. Tah-koo-toh went down there today. He asked me why the people are cold.

lines.text: ...Every great work has a cost, Haruki. Go to bed. The Rite will need you rested.
lines.tts: ...Every great work has a cost, Hah-roo-kee. Go to bed. The Rite will need you rested.

lines.text: ...Yes, Saint.
He cracked it, Sable. With one strike. Without the Calamity.
Then you need the Calamity out of him before the Rite. I can arrange that.
How?
Morvudd is marching across the plains. Toward the Laughing Blade. Let the boy watch his teacher die.
Next time: the plains outside the golden city.
Morvudd comes back, with a horde. Sieg holds the line.
lines.tts: Morvudd comes back, with a horde. Seeg holds the line.

lines.text: And Mr. Sable finally tells me why I am here.
Episode ten. Morvudd.
